quiz.q: Which redirection sends both stdout and stderr into app.log?
quiz.why: Redirect stdout to the file first, then point stderr at stdout. Order is significant.

quiz.q: Why is uniq usually paired with sort?
options: uniq only works on sorted input for duplicate detection
sort is required to read files
quiz.why: uniq collapses adjacent duplicates. Sorting brings identical lines together so they can be counted correctly.

quiz.q: Which command searches a file case-insensitively and prints line numbers?
quiz.why: -i ignores case and -n prints line numbers. -v inverts the match and -r searches recursively.
